acceptance_criteria.criterion: A try/catch(DOMSelectorException) wraps the processEpisode() call in fetchEpisode()
On catch: a subdirectory storage/debug/{alias}--{id}--{YYYYmmdd-HHiiss}/ is created
page.html written to that directory contains the HTML from $e->getHTML()
context.txt written to that directory contains: selector, comic alias, episode ID, URL, exception message, and full stack trace
Successful fetches produce no debug files

summary: Wrapped processEpisode() call in try/catch(DOMSelectorException): creates storage/debug/{alias}--{id}--{date}/, writes page.html and context.txt, re-throws WebcomicsBuilderException with debug path in message.
Used $episode->getComic()->getAlias() in place of spec's $comic->getAlias() (no $comic param in actual method).

comments.note: WP-003 spec used $comic->getAlias() but actual method signature is fetchEpisode(Fetcher, Episode) with no $comic parameter. Adapted to $episode->getComic()->getAlias() which is consistent with how the same pattern is used elsewhere in the file (line 227: $episode->getComic()->createFetcher()).

summary: All acceptance criteria confirmed. FileHelper already imported. Tests 4/4 pass.

comments.note: FileHelper is already imported (line 8). DOMSelectorException use added at line 18 (alphabetical order in the WebcomicsBuilder group). try/catch structure correct, re-thrown exception is plain WebcomicsBuilderException. Tests 4/4 pass.

summary: Logic is clear and correctly placed. Only catches DOMSelectorException, not base exception. Re-throw is correct type. No functional issues.
